title: Lý thuyết Part 2 — Who, Where, When

items.title: Part 2 – Questions & Responses
items.note: Part 2 gồm 25 câu hỏi (7-31), mỗi câu có 3 đáp án phản hồi A, B, C.
rows:
1. Câu hỏi lấy thông tin:
Who, Where, When, What, Why, Which, How

Who is the new manager?
=> Mr.Thompson

2. Câu hỏi xác nhận lại thông tin:
Yes/No questions

Did you do your homework?
=> No, not yet.

There is a mail for you.
=> Who's it from?

items.title: Chú ý
lines: Với dạng câu hỏi lấy thông tin (Who, Where, When, What, Why, Which, How) → LOẠI phương án chứa Yes, No.
Câu trả lời dạng “I don’t know” thường là câu trả lời đúng, bao gồm:
I don’t know = I have no idea.
I don't remember/ I'm not sure.

items.title: I. WHO question
items.note: Đáp án trả lời trực tiếp cho câu hỏi Who thường là:
rows: President, director, manager, supervisor, secretary, assistant, accountant, receptionist, representative, employee, staff, client, customer,…
Sales department, accounting department, maintenance department, marketing department, shipping/delivery department, production department, personnel department/ human resources, …

items.title: II. WHERE question
items.note: Đáp án đúng cho câu hỏi Where thường là:
rows: Giới từ ví trí + Danh từ địa điểm, đồ vật
At a hotel/café, in the office/restaurant/room/drawer, on the table/desk/shelf, down/across the street, on the corner, over there, …
Go to/ to/ try / check + place

items.title: III. WHEN question
items.note: Đáp án cho câu hỏi When thường là mốc hoặc khoảng thời gian, bao gồm:
rows: In a few minutes/ hours/ days, within a week/month/year, …
Yesterday, last, ago, today, tonight, tomorrow, next, soon
In the morning/ afternoon/ evening, at noon/ lunchtime/ night
In spring/ winter/ summer/ fall/ autumn
When, while, before, after, until, as soon as, whenever + MĐ
